chunks: And from him, from al-Khashshab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
I said, 'May God perfect you,' how is the mutual cursing (al-li'an)? He said, 'The Imam sits and places his back towards the Qibla, places the man on his right, and the woman on his left.'

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: The Imam, who presides over the ritual in this context
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: The Qibla, the direction of prayer towards Mecca
key_terms.الْمُلَاعَنَةُ: Li'an, the mutual cursing ritual between spouses to resolve accusations of adultery without witnesses
key_terms.يَقْعُدُ: He sits, describing the presiding posture

ai.seo_question: What is the correct physical arrangement and posture of the Imam during the ritual of Li'an?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific physical arrangement for *al-li'an* (mutual cursing), a procedure for resolving a husband's accusation of adultery without witnesses. It highlights the Imam's central role in presiding over the ritual, with his back to the Qibla and the spouses positioned on his right and left respectively, reflecting the solemnity of the judicial act.
